headline: Trump to meet with Zelenskyy, Netanyahu. And, TPS holders could soon face deportation
context: President Trump is set to hold separate meetings with Ukrainian leader Volodymyr Zelenskyy and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu are today. And, Temporary Protected Status holders may face deportation soon.
